title: From Gist to Verbatim: The Controllable Path of One Image Through a Diffusion Prior
abstract: arXiv:2611.27875v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern generative models are typically studied for their ability to generalize, while memorization is treated as a failure mode. We invert this perspective and ask how a generative model can recall a single datum. We frame memorization as a control problem: a learned conditioning signal steers a frozen diffusion model toward a target image, and we follow the formation of this memory throughout training. Before converging to exact reproduction (verbatim), memory passes through a regime of abstraction: samples preserve the target's semantic content (gist) while remaining diverse in appearance, leaving predictable detail to the generative prior. This semantic organization emerges despite the absence of labels, captions, or any explicit semantic objective. In the abstraction regime, the learned memory approaches ordinary text conditioning and supports editing, one-shot recognition, and retrieval more effectively than in the near-perfect reco

translated_title: 从要义到逐字：一张图像经由扩散先验的可控记忆路径
translated_abstract: 现代生成模型通常因其泛化能力而被研究，而记忆化则被视为一种失败模式。我们反转了这一视角，探究生成模型如何能够回忆起单个数据。我们将记忆化构建为一个控制问题：一个学习到的条件信号引导一个冻结的扩散模型趋向目标图像，并跟踪这一记忆在整个训练过程中的形成过程。在收敛到精确复现（逐字记忆）之前，记忆会经历一个抽象化阶段：样本保留目标的语义内容（要义），同时在外观上保持多样性，将可预测的细节留给生成先验。尽管缺乏标签、描述或任何显式的语义目标，这种语义组织依然涌现出来。在抽象化阶段，学习到的记忆接近普通文本条件化的效果，并且在编辑、单样本识别和检索方面比接近完美复现阶段更为有效。
tldr: 该研究将生成模型的记忆化视为一个可控问题，发现记忆的形成会经历一个抽象阶段——既保留目标图像的语义要义又保持外观多样性，且此阶段比逐字复现更有利于编辑、单样本识别和检索，为理解和利用模型记忆开辟了新路径。
en_tdlr: This paper reframes memorization as a control problem, revealing that memory formation passes through an abstraction regime that preserves semantic gist while remaining diverse in appearance, and that this regime better supports editing, one-shot recognition, and retrieval than verbatim reproduction.
